title: LED Garage Lights 14-Pack – Hexagonal Ceiling Lights 6500K
descriptionHtml:
Dark and gloomy in the garage?

A single bare bulb in the ceiling is not enough when you are tinkering, painting or looking for the right tool. Shadows and weak lights make the job slow, tire your eyes and hide details.

Turn the garage into a pro workshop

This 14-pack of hexagonal LED lights gives 72,420 lumens of razor-sharp 6500K light – like working in daylight. Click them together in any pattern, mount them easily and get an even, shadow-free light across the whole area.

Features

  • 14 lights, 72,420 lm – daylight across the whole garage.
  • 6500K cool white – sharp work light without shadows.
  • Modular pattern – put it together however you like.
  • Easy installation – no electrician skills needed.
  • Energy-saving LED – more light, lower electricity bill.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
